source_scope: exact prior fold1/fold2 validation membership; unchanged frozen source gates and geometry cohort
replay: raw body and receipt -> unchanged development features -> pinned JSON raw tree and probability map -> actor diagnostics
actor_policy: exact game roster and event team; goalies may also be shooters; no current-team lookup
goalie_policy: valid explicit goalie presence plus opposing-team roster goalie; empty net not applicable; contradictions and unknown presence unavailable
partial_policy: unresolved actor withholds applicable event-team roster actors for that game; unknown roster withholds aggregate totals
exposure_policy: eligible unblocked event count only; roster listing is not GP or TOI; no per-60 rates
aggregation_policy: season/game-type/role/player scope; separate team stints; exact complete event membership; labeled partial subtotals; NULL unavailable totals
history: A read-only, hash-checked source-field audit preceded this declaration. This is inspected retrospective diagnostic development, not untouched evaluation.
preservation: additive files only; all original source, actuals, methods, model evidence and prospective reservations unchanged

research.use: methodological distinction between unblocked-attempt xG against and ice-time exposure only; no files, predictions or fitted values used

acceptance: diagnostic completion does not pass model quality, foundation, serving, nightly, forecast or FPAR gates
